Current SMEAR II figure reproduction

Revision: 20261026-flag-555-lowercase. Use the matching codes.zip and data.zip beside the extracted Binder folder. Launch this notebook with Voila for automatic execution. The interface states exactly what is recalculated and what uses saved inputs. The current package is verified locally; previous hosted receipts refer to an earlier published version.

Do the PM mass and aerosol optical properties differ between pollen-labeled and dust-event-associated filters at Hyytiälä?

Click the Binder link once, then wait. Everything will start automatically. Keep the tab open; do not click Run, change settings, or refresh the page. The figures and download links will appear when processing finishes.

The initial Binder build and archive downloads can take several minutes. Progress appears here once this page has loaded.

Version: 20261026-final-typography. Archives are size- and SHA-256-pinned; unavailable new archives cause an error, never an old-release fallback.

σabs,520 and MAC520. Scattering, MSC and SSA: 550 nm.

Automatic default: redraw current Figures 2–8 and S1–S3 from frozen saved/processed inputs; copy exact workflow Figure 1; recompute overlap, counts, medians and Cliff effects from the immutable dust snapshot. Saved uncertainty intervals are not recalculated. No original-instrument-data reconstruction.

After success, optional manual controls can rerun the historical r6 processed-input analysis (5,000/2,000 draws), followed by the same current saved-input figures. Historical outputs are separate; changed settings do not flow into the frozen snapshots. No extra action is needed for the default results.

Python performs the rendering and dust replay. Julia wrappers are shared-Python dispatch, not independent new uncertainty/dust validation. Download results before leaving: Binder storage is temporary.

Processing current figures + dust audit. Keep the tab open; no action is needed.
